SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.post_title, p.post_content, p.post_date, p.post_count, p.post_like_count, p.target_type, p.target_id,
f.file_id AS f_file_id, f.file_name AS f_file_name, f.file_path AS f_file_path, f.target_type AS f_target_type, f.target_id AS f_target_id FROM post p LEFT JOIN file f ON p.post_id = f.target_id AND f.target_type = 'COMMUNITY_REVIEW' WHERE p.post_id = #{post_id}

SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.post_title, p.post_content, p.post_date, p.post_count, p.post_like_count, p.target_type, p.target_id,
f.file_id AS f_file_id, f.file_name AS f_file_name, f.file_path AS f_file_path, f.target_type AS f_target_type, f.target_id AS f_target_id FROM post p LEFT JOIN file f ON p.post_id = f.target_id AND f.target_type = #{targetType} WHERE p.target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY p.post_date DESC
